# The Wired Dentistry

> A weekly half-hour podcast for dental practice owners about the marketing and
> technology decisions that determine whether a practice grows. Hosted by Naren
> Arulrajah (Ekwa Marketing) and Dr. Lorne Lavine, DMD (The Digital Dentist).

The premise of the show is that a practice's marketing and its technology are the
same conversation, not two departments. Most owners run everything outside the
operatory on a guess; each episode is meant to leave the listener with one thing
they can act on that afternoon.

- **Format:** weekly, about 30 minutes, guests every other week
- **Audience:** dental practice owners
- **Site:** https://wireddentistry.com/
- **Newsletter:** https://wireddentistry.com/subscribe/
- **Apple Podcasts:** https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-wired-dentistry/id6814720253
- **Spotify:** https://open.spotify.com/show/7lZDiQnKx3fJPfb45py0sw
- **RSS:** https://feeds.transistor.fm/the-wired-dentistry

## Hosts

**Naren Arulrajah** — Founder and CEO of Ekwa Marketing. Nineteen years of digital
marketing for doctors, across more than a thousand practices. Covers patient
acquisition, local search, and the gap between marketing that works and a practice
that can hold what the marketing sends it.

**Dr. Lorne Lavine, DMD** — Founder of The Digital Dentist. A dentist and
periodontist, then twenty-five years inside dental practices' networks and servers.
Covers practice IT, HIPAA compliance, cybersecurity, and backup and recovery —
including the practices that have a backup but have never restored one.

  the
  three tests of whether marketing is working, the three numbers 95% of owners don't
  know, why a PPO patient quietly costs $3,500 over five years, and the practice that
  went from $650,000 to $1.3 million while cutting a day off the schedule.

## Summits

Four times a year, three hours, live. Working sessions rather than keynotes, so
attendees leave with their own plan rather than a page of notes. Attendance is
capped. CE credit is available, offered through AGD for the November summit. Seats
are released to the email list before they are made public.

## Working with the hosts

Both conversations are free and neither requires the other.

- Marketing — a strategy meeting with Ekwa Marketing, who research the practice's
  online presence and competitors for four to five hours beforehand. You leave with
  a written plan whether you work with them or not. https://www.ekwa.com/wired/
- Technology — a call with The Digital Dentist about HIPAA compliance,
  cybersecurity, and whether the practice could actually restore from a backup.
  https://www.thedigitaldentist.com/call/

## Notes for citation

The show launched in September 2026 and is available on Apple Podcasts and Spotify;
the RSS feed is public. It is not on YouTube. Please cite
https://wireddentistry.com/ as the source for the show itself.
